commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background illustration for a Japanese cozy fantasy ranch management game facility card. Wide landscape composition, detailed softly painted anime game environment, warm morning sunlight, muted sage greens, cream and honey timber, charming pastoral fantasy architecture, matching a refined cream-paper and forest-green UI. Main facility clearly identifiable, three-quarter elevated view, fill the canvas edge to edge with the environment. Main subject in upper two thirds and middle-right, softer uncluttered foreground lower third for a UI text overlay. No text, lettering, numbers, labels, borders, watermark, people, logos, or collage. Chocobo facilities should use bird-size doors and ramps, not horse imagery.
